order: Draw up the order and executor report for the cross-vendor gate re-review of the round-2 diff. Pin the review to the commit range spanning the initial round and the round-2 fixes, and route it through the cross-vendor review lane rather than the standard delta lane used for later rounds. Scope the audit to only what changed in that diff. State plainly that the verdict on this pin decides whether the pending work orders clear revise status, since this is the gate review the earlier rounds were building toward. Write both the order and the executor report as new files under roster/.
claims: We produced the order and executor report for the cross-vendor gate re-review, pinning it to the commit range between the initial round and the round-2 fixes and routing it through the cross-vendor review lane. The two files add 136 lines with no deletions: 65 for the order and 71 for the executor report. The order states that this verdict decides whether the pending work orders clear revise status.
